description: Lean but filmable AUZiX live installer media, currently being proven on ESXi: graphical installer surface, rescue terminal, browser, file manager, SSH, and enough debug/internet tooling to diagnose installs without dragging the full workstation payload into the ISO.

size_budget.notes: This profile may include Xorg/LightDM/Enlightenment and small GUI tools for the installer demo. Office suites, Flatpak applications, Podman demo images, large wallpaper packs, and workstation/media apps remain post-install package groups.

boot_substrate.additional_requirement: Graphical startup must never be the only recovery path; SSH and TTY remain first-class.

rules: Use xterm before Terminology for installer/rescue shell until EFL terminal stability is clean.
The installer launcher must work from E menu and from /System/Tools/launch-auzix-installer.
If graphical startup fails, SSH and TTY must still expose auzix-installer.

explicit_non_goals: No Flatpak apps in the ISO
No Podman demo image payloads in the ISO
No large theme/wallpaper packs in the ISO
No one-off repaired user home fossilized as the installer contract

media_static: ISO contains the normal boot substrate and live squashfs
ISO contains installer plans including workstation-demo.json
boot_smoke: LightDM or live E session reaches a visible desktop
keyboard and mouse work in the graphical session
Install AUZiX launcher opens the safe installer frontend
AUZiX Browser opens Midori or NetSurf
mkfs.ext4, parted, mount, df, du, strace, file, curl, and less are present
install_smoke: destructive disk install preserves install-plan.json and first-boot package queue
installed root boots or produces a clear failing gate receipt

publication.lab_first: Publish build receipts and package repo to ns1 first.
publication.public_mirror: After lab validation, mirror blessed ISO/repo artifacts to Auzietek/IONOS. Current storage check shows roughly 200 GiB free on each Auzietek/IONOS host, enough for current repo and ISO shelves.
publication.public_link_rule: Use the Auzietek Community link policy; do not place raw Discord links in generated ISO/repo artifact headers.

current_lab_fact.status: new ISO is already booted/running with GUI; focus on live acceptance and installer behavior before treating this as only a future pipeline target
